sections.description:
Lingua Forge is a WordPress plugin for sites that publish content in more than one language and want AI assistance built into the editorial workflow — without a paid third-party subscription service or a complex multi-plugin stack.

It combines language routing (path prefix /de/ or subdomain de.example.com), hreflang SEO tags, a language switcher block, AI-powered translation and content generation, meta description management, a terminology glossary, and Translation Memory — all in a single installable plugin with no runtime dependencies beyond WordPress itself.

No subscription. No data leaves your server except the content you actively send for translation or generation. You pay your AI provider directly at API rates.
sections.installation:
1. Download the ZIP from the GitHub Releases page.
  2. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and upload the ZIP.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to Settings → Lingua Forge to enter your AI provider API key and configure your language router.
sections.changelog:
1.7.2 — 2026-05-27

  • Added: Self-hosted automatic update checker — once installed, WordPress checks for new releases every 12 hours and surfaces the standard update badge. First install is manual (ZIP from GitHub Releases); all subsequent updates are one-click from the WordPress admin.
  • Added: "View details" link in the plugin row — opens the plugin-information modal with description, changelog, and installation instructions from the live manifest. Duplicates suppressed; "Visit plugin site" (GitHub) always guaranteed.
  • Fixed: Plugin info modal returns a graceful local fallback instead of "Plugin not found" when the remote manifest is temporarily unreachable.
  • Fixed: PHPStan — $transient typed as \stdClass; includes/ added to analysis paths.

1.7.1 — 2026-05-26

  • Fixed: Target Language dropdown (Meta Boxes and Quick Translate) — now limited to languages active on the server instance. Any instance-configured language absent from the built-in AI map (e.g. Basque/eu) is automatically injected via a new MetaBox::inject_instance_languages() filter callback on linguaforge_translation_languages (priority 5). English language names are resolved via PHP's Locale::getDisplayLanguage(); the uppercased code is used as fallback when the intl extension is unavailable.
  • Fixed: Maintenance tab uninstall warning — internal meta key names removed from the user-facing description.
  • Added: Self-hosted update checker — WordPress now surfaces update notices and runs one-click updates directly from lingua-forge.com.
  • Maintenance: SECURITY.md excluded via .distignore and .gitattributes export-ignore.

1.7.0 — 2026-05-24

  • Subdomain routing mode (de.example.com) — wildcard DNS + TLS required; selectable from Settings → Router → URL structure.
  • Language switcher: fixed on archive/blog pages; viewport overflow auto-right; FSE colour token inheritance.
  • Fix Navigation References: subdomain URL rewriting; base-name derivation from _lf_lang meta.
  • Classic menu auto-add guard.

1.6.5 — 2026-05-20

  • Language-router debug call sites removed; debug_system_init() and debug_request_context() removed — fired on every frontend page load.
  • Link Fixer stale-path fix for template parts.
